_doc: EVA CRYPTO v1 configuration. Every number here is either measured from the real market or deliberately chosen; nothing is a placeholder. Edit this file rather than any .py to change behaviour.
_phase_doc: Phase 1 = intelligence pipeline only. execution.enabled stays false until the pipeline is validated against real data AND the legacy crypto_btc_monitor.py desk is retired. Two systems must never trade this account at once.

account._doc: Numeric rhs_account_number -- crypto tools require this form, NOT the alphanumeric account_number.

DOGE-USD._doc: DOGE's low unit price is NOT low risk. All sizing is dollars-at-risk; coin count is an output, never an input.

_universe_doc: ETH-USD and other Robinhood-supported pairs can be added here without touching strategy code.

execution_costs._measurement_doc: Measured live at 11:05 AM PDT -- peak US session, best liquidity of the day. All three assets landed within 0.01pp of each other, which means ~1.9% is STRUCTURAL (Robinhood's crypto revenue model), not a liquidity artifact. This is the single most important number in this file.
execution_costs._cost_doc: A round trip crosses the ask on entry and the bid on exit. Any target smaller than this is a guaranteed loss before the strategy has any say. This is why EVA Crypto must trade RARELY and hold for LARGE moves -- short scalping is arithmetically dead on this venue.

timeframes._doc: Longer frames set context; shorter frames set timing. A bullish 5m against a bearish 4h scores low by design.

trade_score._threshold_doc: PROVISIONAL and explicitly uncalibrated. The brief is right that these must be set by historical testing, not opinion. Until walk-forward validation exists, only high_conviction (80+) is permitted to trade, and only in Phase 2+.

penalties._penalty_doc: Penalties SUBTRACT from the weighted score. spread_penalty is large on purpose: on a 1.9% venue, spread is not a detail, it is the dominant cost. news_event can zero a score outright (hard veto).

risk._sizing_doc: Sized down from the brief's defaults on 2026-09-01 for two real reasons. (1) SHARED BUYING POWER: crypto and equities draw on the SAME Robinhood account -- measured $178.44 available while Eva already holds ~$72 of MSFT. A $100 crypto position would starve the equity desk, which is the proven system. (2) UNPROVEN on a 1.9%-cost venue: risk stays small until walk-forward results exist. Raise these only after the strategy has real out-of-sample evidence, and only with the equity desk's needs accounted for.
risk._loss_limit_doc: Tightened from -25/-35/-60. At $2 risk per trade these permit ~5 losing trades in a day before halting -- enough to learn something, small enough that a bad regime cannot compound. The account is ~$250 total; a -$30 week is >10% of it, which is already the outer edge of acceptable for an unvalidated system.
risk._max_spread_doc: Set just above the measured 1.89-1.90% structural floor. Tighter than this and EVA could never trade at all; looser and she is paying an abnormal, widened book. This gate catches DISLOCATION, not the normal toll.
risk._min_target_doc: Hard floor, raised 4% -> 8% on 2026-09-01. Below 8% the breakeven win rate exceeds 44% purely from spread, which is not a bet worth taking on an uncalibrated strategy. A target must clear the ~1.9% round trip with real margin or the trade is refused before scoring even matters.
risk._stale_doc: Lateness allowance BEYOND a bar's own 5-minute span, so the real tolerance is up to ~10 minutes of total bar age. Raised 120 -> 300 on 2026-09-01: Coinbase's candles endpoint lags enough that 120s flagged perfectly healthy data as stale and vetoed every trade. Still tight enough to catch a genuinely dead feed within two bars.
risk._no_martingale: Never average down. Never increase size to recover a loss. Not configurable.

position_management._target_doc: Raised 5% -> 10% on 2026-09-01 after quantifying the real venue cost. At a 1.9% round-trip spread on a $100 position ($1.90), a 5%/3% trade nets +$3.10 on a win and -$4.90 on a loss: R:R 0.63 and a 61.3% BREAKEVEN win rate. The spread does not merely shave the edge, it inverts it. At 10%/3% the same trade nets +$8.10 vs -$4.90: R:R 1.65, breakeven 37.7% -- achievable. Do not lower this without redoing that arithmetic.
position_management._hold_doc: Raised 48h -> 120h with the target. A 10% BTC move is a multi-day event, not an intraday one. This is the honest consequence of the venue cost: EVA Crypto is a SWING system that holds for days, not a scalper. A 24/7 market does not mean fast trades -- on a 1.9% venue, fast trades are the one thing guaranteed to lose.

data._disagreement_doc: Coinbase (signals) vs Robinhood (execution) legitimately differ by about the spread. Beyond this, one feed is wrong and EVA must stop rather than trade on a bad price.

execution._enabled_doc: PHASE 1 GATE. false = analyse, score, preview, journal -- but never place. Flipping this true requires: (1) pipeline validated on real data, (2) walk-forward results, (3) crypto_btc_monitor.py retired so only one system trades, (4) explicit human decision.
execution._order_doc: LIMIT at mark, never market. A market order hands over the full ~1.9% spread by definition.

accounting._boundary_doc: Midnight is a REPORTING boundary only. It never force-closes a position -- that is equity-market thinking and does not apply to a 24/7 asset.
